title: Prepare or edit a report
purpose: Choose the project, samples, title and narrative for the next issued version.

sections.title: Access and record scope
paragraphs: Active internal staff with an application role can read this page. Client accounts cannot use staff reporting pages. Project managers, approvers and users with explicit release authority can prepare and edit reports. Admin includes project-manager operational access, but release separately requires the explicit report release permission; admin or superuser status alone does not grant it.

Create first asks for a project. Edit fixes the existing project and starts with saved title, narrative and selections. Editing an issued report changes next-version scope only; existing PDFs remain unchanged and the next release needs an amendment reason.

sections.title: Project step
paragraphs: No projects yet asks for client/project setup first.

items.label: Project
items.description: Required for creation; client projects ordered by client then project. A report cannot combine projects or clients.

items.label: Choose samples
items.description: Continue to scope/sample form without creating a report.

items.label: Choose another project
items.description: Return to creation chooser; current unsaved entries and selections are not saved.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Return to Reports during create or report detail during edit without saving.

items.label: Title
items.description: Required, nonblank, maximum 160 characters. New scopes default to project name followed by analytical report. Printed as report title; outer whitespace is trimmed.

items.label: Case narrative
items.description: Optional, maximum 4,000 characters. Printed explanation of interpretation or limitations; outer whitespace is trimmed.

items.label: Samples
items.description: Select 1 to 100 from this project. Draft saving does not require approval. Every requested test of selected samples is checked at release, not just tests whose results are already entered.

items.label: Search
items.description: Case-insensitive search of this project’s lab/client sample IDs only.

items.label: Show
items.description: Default All samples (selected first). Selected only limits visible rows. All tests approved requires at least one test and every current internal result approved or active external source accepted. Not in any issued report means no result/source from that sample appears in any issued version; inclusion in only draft reports does not exclude it.

items.label: Rows
items.description: 25, 50 or 100; default 25. Invalid picker row sizes fall back to 25.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Re-render at page 1 without saving or validating report fields. Typed title/narrative and selection are carried forward.

items.label: Select all samples on this page
items.description: Select or clear visible rows only. Samples hidden by filtering or paging remain selected and appear in the summary.

items.label: First page / Previous page / Next page / Last page
items.description: Submit surrounding form to navigate without saving or validating; typed entries and off-page selections survive. Rows sort selected first, then newest receipt and lab ID.

items.label: Selection summary
items.description: Total selected, 100-sample maximum and project sample count. More than 100 may be temporarily checked but cannot be saved.

items.label: Lab ID
items.description: Lab sample identity and checkbox label.

items.label: Client sample ID
items.description: Client source identity of the same received sample.

items.label: Collected
items.description: Collection time, or composite collection end.

items.label: Received
items.description: Laboratory receipt time; controls default sample order.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Current receipt outcome. Selecting a held/rejected sample does not clear it.

items.label: Tests approved
items.description: All approved or approved/accepted count of requested tests. Preview still checks QC, preservation and independence.

items.label: In reports
items.description: Links to other scopes containing the sample with draft/issued/amended labels. Current edited report is omitted; one sample may be in multiple reports.

sections.title: Saving and errors
paragraphs: Field errors retain submitted form/selection for correction. An edit uses the original scope revision; if another person saved changes, reload and reapply your intended edits. Retrying the stale form cannot override their change. Empty picker states distinguish no received samples from no matching rows.

items.label: Prepare report
items.description: Validate and create an editable scope, record creator and audit, then open detail. Does not issue a PDF or expose a draft to clients.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Validate and save next-version scope with audit; issued versions remain unchanged. Enter in a text field submits save, not picker Apply.
